paragraphs.text:
You approach the strange man. He seems well-traveled and 
weary, and his long, orange robes are a stark contrast to the fine 
suits and dresses of the New England financial elite. He seems 
decidedly out of place.

You open your mouth as if to speak and find him staring 
intensely at you.

• Make an Anthropology roll: if you succeed, go to 72; if you fail, 
go to 37.
